fusions.name: Festering Graze
fusions.desc: Gores the target for 4 damage, leaving it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds, with a 25% chance of [Diseased] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Brittle Tine
fusions.desc: Snaps the tip off a horn and hurls it at the first enemy in its path for 28 damage. It shatters there, hitting every enemy within 3 tiles for 80% of that.

fusions.name: Reef-Crusted Hide
fusions.desc: For 9 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Growth Rings
fusions.desc: Every hit you land adds a growth ring, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once: you deal 3% more damage per stack (24% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
